split_method: Vineyard-disjoint; test vineyards 1,8,15,22; validation vineyards 4,11,18,25; remaining 20 vineyards train.
onnx_validation: ONNX Runtime CPU inference validated on the held-out test set.
limitations: Only Esca and Healthy survived strict provenance, label-review and duplicate auditing.
Black Rot and Leaf Blight remain excluded pending source clarification.
Dataset source is from India; no Syrian field validation.
Exploratory two-class model only; not integrated into the production classifier.
